abstract: The main findings of the comparison are as follows. Overall, Alvenor improves blood pressure control compared with Standard care. Overall, Brostamide and Standard care reach about the same blood pressure control.
conclusion: In the end, the evidence on each measure reads like this. Overall, Alvenor improves blood pressure control compared with Standard care. Overall, Brostamide and Standard care reach about the same blood pressure control.
section:
### Additional comparison

Standard care is the usual blood pressure treatment given to every patient. Alvenor is a once daily tablet that relaxes the walls of the blood vessels. Brostamide is a water tablet that helps the body clear extra salt. All data for this comparison were collected at the Maplewood Cardiac Group.

Table 5. The measure for each arm, shown subset by subset.

| Subset | Arm | Measure | Count | Total |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Older adults, Normal kidney function, University hospital | Standard care | Blood pressure control | 161 | 300 |
| Older adults, Normal kidney function, University hospital | Alvenor | Blood pressure control | 188 | 300 |
| Older adults, Normal kidney function, University hospital | Brostamide | Blood pressure control | 154 | 300 |

These values are listed for every arm and every subset.
